pages.name: Spanish: Cozio, 4.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 3 developed the light-squared bishop to e3 or g5 (the c1-bishop is dark-squared, and the d2-pawn blocks it); plan 4 named f4 and h4 as knight moves. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Cozio, 4.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote a d4-e4 route; plan 2 sent the f3-knight via d2 to f1-g3 (it is the b1-knight's manoeuvre). Rewritten. British spelling. (The page title says 4.O-O but the moves are 4.c3; title not changed.)

pages.name: Spanish: Cozio, 4.O-O
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 said ...Ng6 challenges the b5-bishop; plan 3 played Nbd2 with the d-pawn on d2. Rewritten around recapturing on c6 with a knight. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Cozio, 4.O-O g6
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...b5 onto the bishop; plan 4 routed the knight to g6, where Black's own pawn stands, and via g8 to f6. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Bird Variation
pages.notes: Overview said the Bird eliminates the Spanish bishop; plan 1 played d4 onto Black's knight; plan 2 called the e-file open. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Bird's, 4.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d2-d4 onto the d4-knight; rewritten around c3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Bird's, 5.d3
pages.notes: Plan 1 broke with d3-d4 onto Black's pawn; plan 2 called the f8-bishop light-squared. Rewritten (reviewer rejected the first wording, which repeated c3 and said ...c6 supports d4; fixed and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Bird's, 5.O-O Bc5
pages.notes: Plan 1 played d2-d4 onto Black's pawn; plan 2 said ...c6 supports d4 (it does not). Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Bird's, 5.O-O Bc5 6.d3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote a c3-d4 route onto Black's pawn; plan 3 rerouted a knight from f3, which is empty, via f1, where the rook stands; plan 2 said ...c6 supports d4. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Bird's, 5.O-O Bc5 6.d3 c6
pages.notes: Plans 1 and 2 used Nbd2-f1-g3 with the rook on f1 and ...b5 onto the bishop, and missed that 6...c6 attacks the bishop; overview said ...c6 supports d4 (reviewer rejected the first rewrite for repeating it; fixed and accepted). British spelling.
